Run it with `--env staging`:

```
python scripts/export.py --env staging
```

`--dry-run` is no longer required for staging. I'm taking your word that ops repointed the bucket. Nothing in the repo shows it, because the script only reads `EXPORT_BUCKET` from the environment.

If `EXPORT_BUCKET` isn't set in your shell, the script falls back to `ledgerline-exports-dev`. It does not pick up a staging bucket by itself. So check that your shell has the staging value, for example:

```
echo $EXPORT_BUCKET
```

You can also confirm it's the right bucket before the real run. The script prints `exporting staging to <bucket> (dry_run=...)`, so a first pass with `--dry-run` shows which bucket it resolved.
